full: TurboImmi is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. All content, scores, form mappings, and AI answers are for educational and organizational purposes only. A licensed immigration attorney must review forms, evidence, and strategy before filing with USCIS or any agency. The validation score measures completeness and internal consistency only. It is not an approval odds estimate and is not a government determination. The attorney directory is a referral and discovery tool. TurboImmi does not assign counsel or practice law. TurboImmi is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by USCIS or DHS. Always verify policy on the official USCIS.gov page linked in citations.
